name: Arizona Capacitors Inc
old_description: Arizona Capacitors was founded in 1951 as "West-Cap".  In 2010, Electro Technik acquired our company.  We design and manufacture a broad range of standard and custom wound film capacitors for Industrial and Military Applications.
about:
Arizona Capacitors Inc. operates from Tucson, Arizona, where it was founded in 1951 under the name West-Cap. The company became a subsidiary of Electro Technik in 2010, joining a portfolio of passive electronic component businesses. Its facility is located at 1100 South Plumer Avenue.

The firm designs and manufactures standard and custom wound film capacitors, including metalized plastic capacitors for industrial use. Its product lines encompass EMI/RFI filters, precision resistors (wirewound, current sense, high temperature, high voltage, ultra-precision, and surface-mount), RF/microwave components such as terminations, resistors, attenuators, circulators, and isolators, and magnetics including standard and custom transformers qualified to MIL-STD-1553 and MIL-PRF-27. Custom capabilities include capacitor assemblies with wire harnessing for military vehicles, recessed pass-through capacitors, multi-channel input capacitor/filters, shock-mounted isolated pass-through capacitors, and high-power multi-channel capacitors. Many designs date to the 1950s, and the company cites over 70 years of continuous service.

Arizona Capacitors serves defense, aerospace, medical, telecommunications, grid, power conversion, industrial, and instrumentation markets. The company's ETI Companies matrix shows its film capacitors, magnetics, filters, resistors, and RF/microwave products crossing these sectors. Concrete examples include military vehicle capacitor assemblies, military 4-channel input capacitor/filters, and high-power 4-channel capacitors.

The company emphasizes its long heritage and ongoing development of new products for future applications. It highlights its MIL-STD certification and CAGE code 0TCV9 as indicators of military compliance, and its integration within Electro Technik's three business units—capacitive/resistive, microwave/RF, and magnetics/transformer products—as a source of expanded capability.
